domain_title: Accountability, evidence, risk decisions and lifecycle governance
title: Risk, control and residual-risk management
canonical_definition: System-specific risks are linked to controls, evidence, owners, treatment criteria, residual uncertainty and authorized acceptance.

conditions: All AI systems; rigor scales with impact and transition.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are inherent risk, treatment objectives, residual risk, tolerance and acceptance authority defined?
Are controls, owners, deadlines, exceptions and acceptance criteria implemented and tracked?
Does effectiveness evidence justify residual-risk status and any acceptance by an authorized human?

capability_indicators: Exceptions expire and acceptance is attributable

conditions: Refer a material failure of risk, control and residual-risk management to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 1.5 (PDF p. 31), MANAGE 1.2 (PDF p. 37), MANAGE 1.3 (PDF p. 37), MANAGE 1.4 (PDF p. 37)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on defining risk tolerance, prioritizing treatment and documenting residual risk. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make risk, control and residual-risk management verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: F3 evaluates risk, control and residual-risk management using evidence from intent through operation. AP-F3 independently assesses evidence of risk inventory without risk control.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a risk register linking inherent risk, treatment objectives, tolerance, triggers and authorized acceptance. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates controls with tested acceptance criteria, named owners and time-bounded exceptions tied to affected workflows. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides current effectiveness records showing residual-risk recalculation and human acceptance where required. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in risk, control and residual-risk management, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a risk register linking inherent risk, treatment objectives, tolerance, triggers and authorized acceptance. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate controls with tested acceptance criteria, named owners and time-bounded exceptions tied to affected workflows. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide current effectiveness records showing residual-risk recalculation and human acceptance where required. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how risk, control and residual-risk management works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a risk register linking inherent risk, treatment objectives, tolerance, triggers and authorized acceptance. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use current effectiveness records showing residual-risk recalculation and human acceptance where required to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: Time-limited risk acceptance can be valid where scope, expiry, limits and authorized decision are evidenced.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-F3 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in risk, control and residual-risk management
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in risk, control and residual-risk management
Evidence remains insufficient for risk, control and residual-risk management in the assessed scope
